title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and build-out of cross-product data services for multiple product lines from one governed data plane.
  • Define the “customer data plane” model: canonical customer identifiers, shared dimensions, and consistent facts used across products.
  • Build and operationalize ingestion patterns for batch, streaming, and event data, with repeatable onboarding for new sources.
  • Own the operational playbook for data reliability: data contracts, quality checks, lineage, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Implement and run access methods that make data usable: curated datasets, secure query interfaces, and product-ready data APIs where needed.
  • Productize customer-facing data products (datasets, metrics, exports, and feeds) with versioning, documentation, and clear ownership.
  • Design data models that fit both operational systems (RDS) and analytics stores (columnar/OLAP), including performance and cost tuning.
  • Ensure data products also power ML workflows: trusted training datasets, feature-ready outputs, and consistent definitions for decision-making.
  • Enable AI automation by delivering reliable, low-latency, governed data products that can be used safely in automated workflows.

A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. title: Senior Data Architect / Senior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks
description:
Remote, occasionally Zurich · 80–100% · Start as soon as possible · 

Xebia pushes the boundaries of what’s possible – and you’re right in the middle of it! We’re not just consultants, but visionaries: with more than 5,000 experts worldwide, we help our clients drive their digital transformation with passion and ambition. At Xebia, it’s about more than recommendations: with innovative solutions, we create a unique combination of technology, people and processes. Our goal is to make our clients digital frontrunners – ready to turn media usage data into insights that make a difference?

About the project
Our client, a large Swiss media company, is building a new platform on Azure Databricks for the usage data of its apps and websites. It will replace the commercial analytics tool they use today. Analysts are starting to work on the new platform now.

Your role
You join the platform team of five developers through Xebia. Most of your time goes into implementing Jira tickets. You build and run the pipelines that take event data from Azure Event Hubs through the bronze, silver and gold layers into the tables analysts and dashboards use. You keep the Databricks and Azure infrastructure in code with Pulumi and ship changes through GitHub Actions. The team creates and refines tickets together and reviews each other's code. You'll also help analysts get started with Databricks and GitHub.

As the senior person in the team, you can advise on anything from implementation details to the overall architecture, while the product owner sets the priorities. Today the role also covers the data model, the infrastructure and the platform costs, and there is room to take on more responsibility over time. The team uses AI coding assistants such as Claude in its daily work.
